_note: One NPC per region, five total as of Stage 6. Lessons are plain, kind, non-judgmental, and never mention investing, stocks, or any specific product. A human-reviewable copy of this exact text also lives in content/lessons.md — keep both in sync if either changes.

npcs.name: Coach Penny
npcs.lesson: Saving a little, often, beats saving a lot, rarely.
npcs.detail: Every time you tuck money into Save, future-you says thank you! It doesn't have to be a lot — small, steady amounts add up faster than most people think.

npcs.name: Sage Willow
npcs.lesson: A need keeps you going. A want makes things fun. Both matter — just know which is which.
npcs.detail: Before you spend, ask: do I need this, or do I just want it right now? There's nothing wrong with wants — just make sure your needs are covered first.

npcs.name: Canyon Keeper Cole
npcs.lesson: A budget just means telling your money where to go, instead of wondering where it went.
npcs.detail: You don't need a lot of money to make a plan for it. Even deciding 'this much for Save, this much for Spend, this much for Give' before you get paid is a budget.

npcs.name: Elder Frost
npcs.lesson: A rainy-day fund is money you save just in case — not to spend, just to feel steady.
npcs.detail: Surprises happen: a bike tire pops, a gift gets forgotten. Having a little extra saved up means a surprise doesn't have to turn into a crisis.

npcs.name: Skyward Sage Luna
npcs.lesson: Big goals are just small, patient steps that didn't give up.
npcs.detail: The farther you can see your goal, the easier it is to keep going when saving feels slow. Every bit you save now is a step your future self already took.
